limitations: Public operator pages identify service brands and websites, not a complete live list of every API, CDN, IP range or regional installation.
Direct routing cannot grant connectivity that the local operator has disabled. Availability differs by operator, region and rollout.
No blanket .ru/.su/.rf bypass, arbitrary shared-cloud/CDN host bypass or guessed network-wide IP ranges.
A service homepage rule covers its subdomains; differently named API/CDN domains require independent provenance.
Existing full: and regexp: rules retain their exact matching semantics.
unmapped_services: Private app-only endpoints for the operator-listed continuous glucose-monitoring products (Dianny, Satellite Online, POCTech, iCan, Syai, FreeStyle Libre, Glutec, Lumiflex, Hematonix, MQ CGM, Medtrum) are not published in the cited operator lists. No generic global medical cloud is guessed.

Regional portals outside the verified gov.ru/mos.ru/government domains, mobile apps such as Inspector, specialized corporate services, vehicle/security apps and regional car/scooter operators can use additional unpublished endpoint domains.
Ozon separately named CDN endpoints, additional private mobile APIs, and tenant paths on shared cloud/CDN providers require observed traffic or official endpoint documentation.
Operator internal dynamic IP admission lists are not public and cannot be reconstructed completely from public service names.
media_selection: The user narrowed additional media to sites with verified foreign-IP/VPN denial. The full RKN registry was researched and archived but no mass media-domain import is enabled. Operator-listed media remain direct on the independent operator-whitelist basis.
